config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
set comment "Host example.com (Info line)"
next

edit "Prefix-10.5.0.0/16"
set subnet 10.5.0.0 255.255.0.0
set comment "Net 10.5.0.0"
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-10.5.0.0/16"
next

end
